narrative.intro: Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory obligated $132M in FY2027 to date across 20 awards, producing an average award size of $6.6M. Obligations fell 94.0% year over year. Historical context shows larger full-year totals: FY22 obligations were $1.6B, FY23 obligations were $2B, FY24 obligations were $2B, FY25 obligations were $2.4B, and FY26 obligations were $2.2B. The FY2027 figure is a partial, fiscal year to date total. The agency-level breakdown for FY2027 to date lists National Aeronautics and Space Administration at $132M. The market-level breakdown for FY2027 to date shows Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $131M and Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences at $235K. The note clarifies that all figures are contract obligations except that largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables report total contract values. This summary focuses on obligations and the FY2027 to date snapshot without implying future performance or using figures not provided here.
